title: Long Division Calculator
description: Divide two whole numbers with every long-division step, bring-down digits, quotient and remainder.
howto: Enter the dividend and the divisor.
Press Divide to run the long division.
Read each bring-down step, then the quotient and remainder.

faqs.a: This tool works with whole numbers only, so the bring-down steps stay exact.
It is what is left over after the divisor has been subtracted as many whole times as possible: dividend = divisor × quotient + remainder.
No — division by zero is undefined, so the tool asks for a non-zero divisor.
